evidences.text: Emissary is related to the Elise Trojan and the Operation Lotus Blossom attack campaign, which prompted us to start collecting additional samples of Emissary.

Targeting In contrast to Elise, which was used in attacks against multiple Southeast Asian countries in region appropriate languages, all of the Emissary decoys we’ve collected are written in Traditional Chinese, which is used primarily in Taiwan and Hong Kong.
In contrast, the Elise samples used a mix of actor­registered and DDNS, with the actor­registered serving as one of the data points we used to tie all of the activity together.

While the use of DDNS can make tying activity together more difficult, and despite the new Emissary variants since our publication, two of the most recent C2s resolved to IPs used by Elise C2s detailed in Operation Lotus Blossom.
The other campaign code associated with the out­of­sequence sample was “IC00001”, which could denote an attack payload as it appears to be a plausible code to describe a campaign.

While this may be coincidental, the out­of­sequence version 3.0 sample was created ten days after we published the Operation Lotus Blossom paper that exposed the Elise Trojan that is closely related to Emissary.
